issues.detail: The Hebrew place name 'קָנָה' (Kanah) is a proper noun referring to the Wadi Kanah (溪谷/kanah brook). The Chinese renders it as '買取的溪谷' ('the purchased wadi'), which is a mistranslation of the proper name as a common verb/noun ('acquired/purchased'), changing the identity of the geographical feature. It should be transliterated as '加拿溪谷' or similar.
